sources.summary: Campus Deleers is Europe's first building to bring education and urban production together under one roof. Located along Brussels' canal, the project by SMAK Architects transforms a former industrial brownfield into a mixed-use neighborhood and demonstrates how Brussels' vision of the Productive City can be realized.
